g.text: What it patches
Five targets, each pinned to the version the fixes were written against. Nothing of theirs is shipped or changed.
NUMINA 2.3.13
F-2 slider values clamped to 0..1
F-3 the suit ticks once per tick
F-9 English names (misnamed lang file)
F-10 fire immunity as a server setting
MODULAR POWERSUITS 2.3.13
F-1 creative install needs creative mode
F-4 player update on the tick only
F-5 Night Vision charges every 9 s
F-6 Kinetic Generator pays per block
F-7 Shock Absorber absorbs what it can
F-8 Energy Shield absorbs hits for FE
EMI 1.1.24, OPTIONAL
F-11 null items no longer drop recipes
F-12 JEI tooltip methods EMI lacked
F-13 Tinkers' fluid unit lines
F-14 JEI widgets: arrows, icons, areas
F-15 JEI text widgets are drawn
Skipped on servers and without EMI
needs JEI 15.74 beside EMI; client only
MINECRAFT 1.20.1, THE CLIENT'S CONNECTION
F-16 a packet queued before a server switch
moved the protocol is dropped, not sent
F-17 the disconnected screen opens on the
render thread (Client Reset Packet set it elsewhere)
matter on clients switching servers through Velocity; inert elsewhere
JEI 15.74, OPTIONAL
F-19 JEI starts only after the server's tags
arrive, so Mekanism's and Electrodynamics'
tag-based recipes show on a server
Skipped on servers and with any other JEI
any 15.74 build; client only
